answer_1.quote: We study different ranking losses unified under the LiPO framework on the popular Reddit TL;DR summarization and AnthropicHH dialogue datasets, and provide further verification on OpenAssistant dataset ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses (summaries for TL;DR and dialogue replies for AnthropicHH/OpenAssistant)

answer_2.quote: Our experiments use three different approaches to evaluate following existing protocols : Proxy Reward Model, AutoSxS, and human evaluation.

answer_3.quote: AutoSxS computes the relative win rate of generated response against SFT target over the SFT validation split using large instruction tuned model (PaLM 2-L-IT) via few‑shot in‑context learning.

answer_4.quote: We conduct side‑by‑side human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk. Given a document and three responses ... raters are asked to assign a pointwise overall quality (1‑5) to each response, and choose the best one.
answer_4.guideline: Raters assign an overall quality score (1‑5) to each response and select the best response among the candidates.
